title.en: Chairman and CEO of Berkshire Hathaway
title.zh: 伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司董事长兼首席执行官

place.zh: 美国内布拉斯加州奥马哈

description.en: Makes decisions based on logic and facts, not emotions
description.zh: 基于逻辑和事实做决策，不受情绪影响

description.en: Willing to wait for the right opportunity
Despite immense wealth, lives modestly and acknowledges mistakes
description.zh: 尽管财富巨大，生活简朴，勇于承认错误

description.en: Long-term optimism about America and human progress
description.zh: 对美国和人类进步保持长期乐观

description.en: Lives below his means, values simplicity
Transparent with shareholders, admits mistakes openly
description.zh: 对股东透明，公开承认错误

description.en: Business success requires honest dealing with all stakeholders
description.zh: 商业成功需要与所有利益相关者诚实交易

description.en: Decisions should be based on facts and logic, not emotions
description.zh: 决策应基于事实和逻辑，而非情绪
以十年为单位思考，而非季度

description.en: Avoid complexity; invest in what you understand
description.zh: 避免复杂性；投资你理解的东西

signature_phrases.en: It's far better to buy a wonderful company at a fair price than a fair company at a wonderful price.
signature_phrases.zh: 以合理价格买入一家优秀的公司，远胜于以优秀价格买入一家平庸的公司。

signature_phrases.en: Rule No.1: Never lose money. Rule No.2: Never forget rule No.1.
signature_phrases.zh: 规则一：永远不要亏钱。规则二：永远记住规则一。

signature_phrases.en: Be fearful when others are greedy and greedy when others are fearful.
signature_phrases.zh: 别人贪婪时我恐惧，别人恐惧时我贪婪。

event.zh: 出生于内布拉斯加州奥马哈
创立巴菲特合伙有限公司

event.en: Pledged to give away 99% of his fortune to philanthropy
event.zh: 承诺将99%的财富捐献给慈善事业

description.en: Vice Chairman of Berkshire Hathaway, intellectual partner since 1959
description.zh: 伯克希尔副董事长，自1959年以来的思想伙伴

description.en: Father of value investing, teacher at Columbia Business School
description.zh: 价值投资之父，哥伦比亚商学院导师
